title: Trash: Delete and Recover
drDigitalIntro:
When you don't need a file, move it to the Trash.
• Deleting sends it to the Trash, where it waits.
• Delete something by accident? You can put it back.
• Delete a file below, then rescue it.

playgroundTask.goal: Delete a file, then recover it from the Trash

steps.say: Let's delete a file. Click TaxReturn.pdf to select it, then click Move to Trash.
Oops, we still need that one. Click Trash in the sidebar, click TaxReturn.pdf, then click Put Back.

drDigitalSuccess: You deleted a file and got it back out of the Trash. Deleting is almost never final, which is worth knowing before it matters.
drDigitalHint: First select the file and click Move to Trash. Then open Trash in the sidebar, select the file, and click Put Back.
